script.text: As for Zuzu, Celina captured and locked her in a cage.
Celina! What's gotten into you? You're supposed to be on my side!
On your side? Get real! I'm working for the Professor now.
Aaaah!
Zuzu!
In Leo Akaba's chambers, Yusho confronted his old friend.
At long last, Yusho.
Leo, how could you do this? How could the creator of the ARC system who brought smiles to so many faces now want to hurt people?
Haven't you ever wondered why each of the four dimensions has a different summoning method? It's because all four dimensions used to exist as one… before they were separated.
When my ARC system finally made its public debut in this world, it caused a sensation!
But no one could foresee that my invention would lead to disaster.
Disaster?
Unknowingly, I had unleashed a force I couldn't control. And the trouble all began with a duelist known as Z-ARC!
This duelist took great joy in crushing his opponents! And the more brutal the takedown, the more the crowd cheered!
And that's when I realized that with my ARC technology, I didn't create mere holograms! I created real-life monsters! As Z-ARC unleashed his fury on the world, so did his dragons!
If we couldn't defeat him, the least we could do was try and stop him. And stop him we did.
You were able to stop him? How?
Yuya!
Dad! I can't believe I finally found you! I really could use your help now, Dad. They kidnapped Zuzu!
Zuzu?! Leo… I don't know what your ultimate plan is, but kidnapping an innocent girl? Whatever you're up to, just put an end to it. For my sake. And for my son's sake.
No, Yusho. I'm afraid I cannot. And especially not for your son, or shall I say, your so-called son.
What exactly do you mean?
Zuzu! Celina! Rin! Lulu! What have you done with them?
Though freed from their mind control, the four were trapped inside glass capsules.
You got some nerve locking me up in here, Professor!
Now now, Celina. You might not realize this, but I'm doing it for your own good.
Since I created this problem, I created a solution. Four cards to defeat Z-ARC. However, my cards were stolen.
Stolen? But why? By who?
By someone I care more about than life itself. By Ray… my daughter.
Daughter!?
Yes. Ray used the cards to fight against Z-ARC, but as a result, she split the dimensions into four. And she also split herself into four!
What do you mean?
You four are my daughter, Ray!
That means Zuzu… is also Ray.
Exactly. So if I'm to bring my Ray back, then I must reunite the dimensions and these girls back into one!
Bring her back?!
Correct. That is why I launched my ARC Area Project and the ARC-V Reactor!
I dispatched my students to the other dimensions with a single mission: turn people into cards.
Reuniting all four dimensions requires energy. Life energies of the people I've sealed inside those cards!
I don't believe it.
Declan, you must join my side. And together, we must defeat Yuya!
Defeat Yuya!?
Similar to how Ray was split into four individuals, so was Z-ARC! The piece of Z-ARC from the Standard Dimension is Yuya!
To make certain that Z-ARC can never resurrect again, we must eliminate him!
Are we really pieces of Z-ARC?
Hey – you're wrong! I'm not evil! Because I duel to bring joy to the world! ...At least that's what I hope.
You do, Yuya. Because I was there and I've seen it with my own eyes.
Ah, here you are.
It's… you!
Where are your manners? I do have a name, you know. It's Yuri. And I'm here to absorb you, like I did your friend Yugo.
Not a chance!
Yuya! This is one duel you must absolutely win!
Let's do this!
